objective: The exhaustion decision is representable under the committed event contract: the ceiling is checked before the counter advances, so attempt and ticks never exceed the budget they name.
decision_supported: Should the counters advance past the ceiling before the abort is emitted? No: the resulting payload is rejected, so the one audit record that explains the stop is the one that cannot be persisted.
acceptance: An exhaustion decision has attempt <= max_attempts and ticks <= max_recovery_ticks.
The abort still names the budget and stays terminal.
stop_conditions: The change would need an event contract change.
risks_and_fallbacks: The abort now fires one verification earlier in counter terms; the number of retries is the same because the ceiling is the same.
